content:
q07.
`web/src/connect.ts`

The ConnectRPC service clients are created there via `createClient(...)` calls against a shared `createConnectTransport` (`web/src/connect.ts:184`), producing the exported clients — `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, and `identityProviderServiceClient` (`web/src/connect.ts:192-203`).
